summary: Flexible Solutions International filed an 8-K reporting the resignation of director and audit committee chairman John Bientjes after nearly thirty years of service, effective August 31, 2026. The resignation was not due to any disagreement with the company. Dr. Kim Reid was appointed as a director and audit committee member, and Davis Fynn became audit committee chairman. No executive officer or CEO departure is involved. The event appears routine and amicable, more akin to an ordinary board transition than a forced or abrupt departure. The filing does not state any specific price, premium, or deal terms, and there is no indication of strategic transactions. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; the change is procedural.
